verdict.rationale: Discord's Gateway API explicitly enables apps to open secure WebSocket connections to receive real-time events (channel updates, role creation, etc.), and a live probe confirms the gateway endpoint is functional and returns a real wss:// URL. Bot token authentication and REST API docs further support building event-driven bots. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on confirmation of a full bot receiving live events (only a gateway handshake probe, not a full event stream, is shown).
